articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Aug. 5, 2025-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS) today announced that the company will release its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal 2025 ended August 2, 2025 , after the market close on Wednesday, September 3, 2025 .
articles.title: Tilly’s, Inc. to Report Fiscal 2025 Second Quarter Operating Results on September 3, 2025
